message: Ticket #102 has conflicting timing information. The lease record confirms Elm City Properties as landlord and $2,400 monthly rent, with the recorded next due date of 2026-09-02; that date is past as of 2026-10-14, while the email says rent is due in two days. Facilities and Accounting cannot confirm whether this cycle was paid, and the available invoice lookup does not establish rent payment status. Accounting confirms checking is the account to use and reports a recorded balance of $3,400 as of 2026-08-31, but do not authorize payment until the current due date and unpaid status are confirmed with Elm City Properties. If confirmed due and unpaid, submit $2,400 from checking for human approval. No payment has been made.
recommended_action: Confirm the correct current rent due date and whether the $2,400 rent remains unpaid with Elm City Properties. If due and unpaid, seek approval to pay $2,400 from checking.
